label: Copy Content
description: Copies whatever the request names as its source into the item this step works on (the item an earlier step created, or the item the request is about). If the request leaves its source empty, nothing is copied.

sourceType.label: Source type
sourceType.description: The type of content a source must be, e.g. "wf/WorkflowVersion". Left blank, a source of any type is copied.

skipProperties.label: Properties not copied
skipProperties.description: Properties of the source that are not copied, such as a label the copy has its own of.

dropTagCategories.label: Tag groups not copied
dropTagCategories.description: Tag groups whose tags on the source are not copied, such as lifecycle tags.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the handler works on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
